start: An open whole-gym delete request with 'called' and 'reminded' ticked; signed in within the last 15 minutes

steps.action: Type the gym code in 'Type the gym code' and tap 'Delete the gym for ever'
user_sees: Question 'Delete <gym> for ever? Every member, receipt and record of this gym is erased. This cannot be undone.'
must_not: The delete starting before the question is answered

user_sees: 'Deleted <gym>. Checked <n> tables: nothing left. Pictures removed: <n>. Now tell the gym it is done.'
must_not: Members of the gym still able to sign in to it

steps.action: Open All gyms, then reopen Delete requests
must_not: The request still open with its delete button

start: Same delete, but some pictures cannot be removed from storage

steps.action: Type the code, tap 'Delete the gym for ever', OK
user_sees: 'Deleted <gym>. Checked <n> tables: nothing left. Pictures removed: <n>. <m> pictures are left: remove them in the Supabase dashboard (Storage). Now tell the gym it is done.'
Log line 'Some pictures were left after a delete'
must_not: Pictures left with no word on screen or in the log

steps.action: Type a wrong code, tap 'Delete the gym for ever', OK
user_sees: 'That is not this gym’s code. Nothing was deleted.'
Log line 'A gym delete was refused (nothing deleted)'

steps.action: With a sign-in older than 15 minutes, type the right code and tap the button, OK
user_sees: 'For this, sign in again first (it must be within the last 15 minutes).' and a 'Sign in again' button
must_not: The gym deleted on an old sign-in

steps.action: Type the right code, tap the button, then Cancel in the question

start: A gym was just deleted from its request card

steps.action: Without reloading, look at the same request card
must_not: A second tap on 'Delete the gym for ever' giving a confusing error with no word that it is done

steps.action: Try to open the gym's old HQ page link
user_sees: Words that the gym is not there any more
must_not: Any of the gym's members, receipts or pictures shown

start: A gym asked to leave MettleUp 20 days ago and the call is done

must_not: Member photos, receipts or any record of the gym left in any table
The delete done later than 30 days after the request
